result.explanation: Use a single lease record. Before each operation, advance time when requested, then expire if the deadline is reached. Acquire increments the monotonic generation only when vacant; renew and release require the current owner and generation.
result.mapping: state={now,owner,generation,expires}; output mirrors these fields plus status. null owner/expires represent vacancy.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the published validity constraints; event fields are present and arithmetic remains safe.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let t=0,o=null,g=0,x=null,L=input.config.ttl;for(let i=0;i<output.length;i++){let e=input.events[i],s=output[i];if(e.type==='advance')t+=e.dt;if(x!==null&&x<=t){o=null;x=null}let z='ignored';if(e.type==='advance')z='advanced';else if(e.type==='acquire'){if(o===null){g++;o=e.owner;x=t+L;z='acquired'}else z='busy'}else if((e.type==='renew'||e.type==='release')&&o!==null&&o===e.owner&&g===e.generation){if(e.type==='renew'){x=t+L;z='renewed'}else{o=null;x=null;z='released'}}let q={status:z,owner:o,generation:g,expires:x,now:t};if(JSON.stringify(q)!==JSON.stringify(s))return false}return true}
